text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In front of a restaurant, a flag advertising a special fair flutters in the wind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer… am I dreaming? What do you see written on that flag?
choice_data_list: "Unlimited Mont Blanc buffet! Eat till you drop!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is this not a dream?! Who did this?! Who thought up this sinful fair?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ahh, I can smell the chestnut cream from here… And it's 3 p.m., the time of day when a young lady's heart may waver…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: There is no possible way for me to fight this temptation.
choice_data_list: This is a rare opportunity, so why fight it? I'll join you.
This is a rare opportunity, so why fight it? I'll join you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Thank goodness. If you had told me to go alone, well… I have little confidence I would have been capable of self-restraint.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, what do you think I should do? I see an incline of temptation rising before me, like the slope of Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Shall I run up it at full speed?
choice_data_list: Why not take a measured approach?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ahem… Y-you are right, of course… Mont Blanc is a dessert to be consumed with elegance and dignity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall eat in moderation. That's what I had in mind to start with, for what it's worth. It is what's proper.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …You're very cruel, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No… Well, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew, that went well. My sweet tooth was sated after the first plate. I managed to control myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We'd best not approach this restaurant for a while. Better safe than sorry, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen stops herself from eating too much. Not overloading on sugar seems to have helped her keep a clear head.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Are those your instructions?! I can't decide whether to shake your hand or slap you in the face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Very well, I shall brace myself. Let's begin our journey, to reach the other side of this slope.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hic… What a magnificent, yet regrettable experience. On the one hand I'm satisfied, on the other, I'm plagued with guilt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Was that a creak just now?! Trainer, please tell me that came from your mouth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, surely that's the case. No matter how much I may have eaten, it couldn't be so much that the asphalt would creak beneath me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall burn off what I ate through training. Now to throw myself wholeheartedly into it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although we overindulge, Mejiro McQueen's potential seems to grow in proportion to the number of calories she consumes.
